content:
Has there ever been any discussion in adding some Topological games, like the Banach-Mazur or Choquet game? I dont find anything at least.

If yes, I may be interested in defining them. Unfortunately these games usually go on "forever" and have a generalised notion of winning strategy. Is that still in the scope of the repository?

Aren't these examples of Gale-Stewart games? I think those might rather belong to the Borel determinacy repo
https://github.com/sven-manthe/A-formalization-of-Borel-determinacy-in-Lean
